title: Drink Milk Behavior
description: Allows the mob to drink milk based on specified environment conditions.

cooldown_seconds.title: Cooldown Seconds
cooldown_seconds.description: Time (in seconds) that the goal is on cooldown before it can be used again.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Conditions that need to be met for the behavior to start.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.
